purpose: Implement the board-specific GPON timeout drain with retained transaction ownership and honest flush failure reporting

authority.stop_abort: aal_gpon_deinit@0xfb300 resets PON control94 and GPON control7c; native interrupted-stop resets its owned PUC/PDC/GTC and invalidates configuration

behavior: O5/O6 exit schedules GPON-only drain and masks GPON events until tables are released; O6 grace remains intact
Empty/complete/partial queues use original PVT/Alloc-ID/valid/PUC/GTC mechanisms; only the partial queue needs a64-byte probe with fully initialized data
Flush timeout or nonzero final queue counters preserve the current transaction and return real errors; retry does not resubmit an already issued flush
Public PUC/PDC and OMCI table commits cannot overwrite GPON or XGTC recovery-owned state; recovery-internal XGTC PUC initialization remains available
Explicit stop cancels queued or active recovery and resets interrupted PUC/GTC state, requiring fresh configuration
GPON activation reports recovering plus actual error; new activation during recovery returnsEBUSY

validation.production_driven: Actual GPON worker/helpers, stop, activation and public PUC/PDC entries extracted into a compiled MMIO/NI boundary model; ASan/UBSan passed for7 cases including busy probe, stuck flush, nonempty completion, resumed completion and explicit stop before/after work starts
validation.other_directed: Actual GPON IRQ grace/expiry and pending-event retention; real binary ITU uploads reject recovery-owned commits including empty snapshots; existing family isolation and XGTC recovery checks passed
validation.arm64: 12 current PON translation units and NI xram object compiled, relocatable partial link resolves GPON recovery and NI gate; input/object hashes recorded
model_boundaries: NI probe acceptance and counter arrival
Locks, delays, GPIO and NI invalidation
validation.factory_policy_difference: Native temporary PVT updates preserve the established global buffer policy and restore existing field owners; global buffer-policy recalculation is not replayed as a hardware-verified operation
remaining_hardware_checks: Actual GPON FIFO completion and partial-packet probe behavior
IRQ replay after GPON recovery unmasks the source
GPON OLT registration and business recovery timing

live_baseline.scope: Previously deployed RAM module; does not validate this new GPON implementation
